profile.headline: Data Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in SQL, C#, Python, Scala. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Information Technology focused in Computer Software Engineering from University of Phoenix.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
·	Implemented property data pipeline compiling property data from various data sources into a common data store for use by the Reporting, Sales and Servicing teams.
·	Implemented microservice that would obtain Bing Geocode locations for addresses of properties to enhance the property information in the property data pipeline
·	Implemented a document sync solution to use while migrating legacy document management service to a cloud based document management service.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Terraform · PySpark · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Assist Systems Team for the University of Utah Health Plans in maintaining existing apps and tools to help our enrollment and EDI teams manage health plans administration.
Developed in internal Web app to assist health plans employee's automate repetitive Jira task creation saving time spent by employee creating Jira tickets by about 80%.
Technology/Languages: C#, .Net, InterSystems Caché m-code, Epic (www.epic.com)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Senior Engineer contributing to development of Intelligence dashboard.
*Contributed to migrating the intelligence dashboard architecture to Amazon Web Services.

Technology/Languages:
*Scala
*Python
  *Pyspark
*Apache Spark 2
*Apache Cassandra
*Docker
*Amazon Web Services (AWS):
  *CodeCommit, Glue, Lambda, Athena, Redshift, CloudFormation, Cloudwatch

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
*Responsible for writing test automation for company database access service.
*Assist as Quality Assurance lead on my team, ensuring test automation for critical code functions and methods.
Assisted as Quality Assurance engineer during release performing go-no-go and smoke tests during deployment ensuring new features are functioning.

Technology/Language:
*SQL Server
*SQL Server Integration Services
*SQL Server Analysis Services
*Excel
*T-SQL
*DAX
*C#
*Amazon Web Services
*Python
*Spark
*Scala
*Hadoop

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Assisted in ensuring SQL stored procedures run.
Modified SQL Stored procedures to accommodate new reports.
Assisted in connecting report data from database to Dashboard UI.

Technology/Languages:
Java
SQL Server
Domo

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Ensured data was available for Buyers to track product performance, sales velocity, returns etc.
Assisted in writing user stories for company providing developers with acceptance criteria.

Technology/Languages:
Oracle SQL Developer
Terradata
HTML

positions.title: Associate Buyer
positions.description: Assisted Buyer in selecting and negotiating costs of product to list for sale online.
